theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors exhibit strong relative momentum (rank #2) with a durable uptrend (hurst trend, durability bar 0.58) and improving breadth (0.318) without crowding. falsifier.text: Breadth falls below 0.7 OR durability drops below 0.80, indicating internal deterioration beyond what crowding alone suggests.
